description:
Create a new empty Photoshop document with specified dimensions and color mode.

Use when: starting a design from scratch or no document is open.
Do NOT use when: opening an existing file — use photoshop_open_image.

Returns: created document id and name.
Preconditions: none. Side effects: creates a new document and makes it active.

document_id.description: Ignored. photoshop_create_document and photoshop_open_image do not target an existing tab. Omit this, or send null or 0.

height.description: Document height in pixels. Default 1080 when the request names no size.

width.description: Document width in pixels. Default 1920 when the request names no size.

name: photoshop_create_document
